description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.003 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Sitemap to URL list: give a sitemap URL or just a domain (sitemaps found via robots.txt, then /sitemap.xml). Follows sitemap indexes (newest first, up to 10 child sitemaps), reads .xml, .xml.gz and text sitemaps, and returns every URL with lastmod, changefreq, priority, hreflang alternates, image and news counts. Filter by contains= and since= (lastmod). When to use: Use sitemap to list all pages a site declares (with lastmod) before crawling or to find recently changed pages. Use robots-check for crawl permission of one URL.

contains.description: only URLs containing this text, e.g. /blog/

max_sitemaps.description: sitemap files to read per call, 1-10, default 5

since.description: only URLs with lastmod at/after this ISO date

url.description: sitemap URL, or a site / domain to discover its sitemaps via robots.txt
